source: docs/proj_v3.md section 2 (D1-D4 as amended by review; approved)

holes.budget_definition: new hole cells on the object (M_synth & obj, M_sensor excluded) / object cells at 224
holes.centre_on: object cells with M_sensor = 0 (no lie mask: placement never looks at M_lie)
holes.lie_rule: cover, never reject or clip: lie cells inside an ellipse become part of M_synth (flagged and completed). Deviation from SPEC_hypotheses M_synth row, recorded in docs/proj_v3.md and notes/holes_decision_v1.md
holes.covered_lie_note: per sample, covered_lie_frac = lie_any@12 cells in M_synth / M_synth cells, carried in every batch next to hole_frac

augment.flip_axis_note: no augmentation (no-augmentation decision): the shadow-side statistic found no consistent stereo baseline side, so no flip is known to be safe; deviation from GR-ConvNet. Revisit only if overfit-20 or the validation curves show clear overfitting. With flip_axis null, augment=True is refused.
augment.angle_rule: theta -> -theta (sin 2theta negated, cos 2theta kept) for either flip

depth_norm: configs/frozen_day1.json normalisation: ds_comp_mm for R/A0/M, dstar_mm for A*
corruption_seed_note: validation / test holes are keyed by this seed with epoch 0, never by the run seed
